# BudgetGo

> BudgetGo is a personal-finance app for iPhone. Its tagline is "Let's make sense of all of it." It brings spending together from voice entry, Apple Pay, bank SMS alerts, Apple Wallet (FinanceKit), banks linked through Plaid, imported statements, and manual entry. AI categorizes every transaction, and personalized insights and analytics show where money goes and where to save. Users can review and edit every transaction, category, and allocation.

BudgetGo is published by GraphLeaf LLC and is available on the App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/budgetgo-track-budget/id6761938917

Key facts:

- Platform: iPhone (iOS). Automations use Apple's built-in Shortcuts app.
- Modes: one active budget at a time (a spending limit for the period, allocated across categories), or tracking-only mode with no budget.
- Transaction sources: voice entry (say what you spent, then review before saving), Apple Pay payments (Shortcuts Wallet automation), bank SMS alerts (Shortcuts Message automation), Apple Wallet accounts through FinanceKit, one or more banks linked through Plaid where supported, imported files (PDF bank statements, CSV and Excel exports, receipt photos), and manual entry.
- Imports: PDF, Excel, or CSV up to 5 MB and 500 transactions per file. Duplicates already imported from the same file are skipped, nothing is added until the user confirms, and uploaded files are deleted after 24 hours.
- SMS alerts are parsed on the device. Only recognized financial messages create transactions.
- Privacy: PII filters limit sensitive details during AI analysis, biometric unlock is available, and BudgetGo does not sell personal information.
- AI categorizes transactions automatically. Users can change any category.
- Insights: a playable recap of short stories covering pacing, saving opportunities, overspending, lifestyle creep, and period comparisons, plus end-of-period budget reviews with suggestions.
- Analytics: spending trend (day, week, month), forecast and safe-to-spend, cash flow (money in vs out), top merchants, and payments.
- Recurring bills and subscriptions are detected and shown as upcoming charges ("Due this week").
- Data export: transactions can be exported as CSV, PDF, or Excel.
- Support: support@budgetgo.ai

## Pages

- [Home](https://budgetgo.ai/): Product overview: ways to add spending, connected banks, AI sorting, insight stories, analytics, upcoming bills, budget modes, privacy safeguards, and FAQ
- [Automation setup guide](https://budgetgo.ai/automations.html): Separate iPhone video walkthroughs and written steps for Apple Pay and bank SMS automations in Apple Shortcuts, plus troubleshooting
- [Apple Pay setup video](https://budgetgo.ai/automations.html#wallet-video): 1 minute 28 seconds, with highlighted taps and pause/full-screen controls
- [Bank SMS setup video](https://budgetgo.ai/automations.html#sms-video): 1 minute 58 seconds, with highlighted taps and pause/full-screen controls; use a filter specific to your bank
- [BudgetGo MCP (coming soon)](https://budgetgo.ai/mcp.html): Waitlist for the upcoming BudgetGo Model Context Protocol server, which will let MCP-compatible AI assistants answer questions using a user's BudgetGo spending data
- [Blog](https://budgetgo.ai/blog/): Guides on budgeting, tracking spending, saving, and how BudgetGo works
- [Zero-Based Budgeting, Explained (With a Monthly Example)](https://budgetgo.ai/blog/zero-based-budgeting.html): Zero-based budgeting explained step by step: how to give every dollar of take-home pay a job, a full $4,200 monthly example, how to handle irregular income, and how to run it in BudgetGo.
- [7 Ways to Get Your Spending Into BudgetGo (and Which Ones to Use)](https://budgetgo.ai/blog/ways-to-add-spending-to-budgetgo.html): Voice, Apple Pay, bank SMS alerts, Apple Wallet, connected banks, statement imports and manual entry: every way to add spending to BudgetGo, and the best setup for you.
- [Voice Expense Tracking: Log Spending by Just Saying It](https://budgetgo.ai/blog/voice-expense-tracking.html): Voice expense tracking lets you log a purchase by saying it out loud. Here's how it works, what to say, when it beats automatic tracking, and how to make it a 10-second habit.
- [Turn Bank SMS Alerts Into a Spending Tracker (Apple Shortcuts Guide)](https://budgetgo.ai/blog/track-spending-from-bank-sms-alerts.html): How to track spending from bank SMS alerts automatically: set up an Apple Shortcuts Message automation, keep it limited to your bank, and fix it when an alert doesn't log.
- [Spending by Merchant: Why Your Top Merchants Say More Than Your Categories](https://budgetgo.ai/blog/top-merchants-where-your-money-goes.html): How to track spending by merchant to see where your money really goes: a worked monthly example, the five kinds of merchants to look for, the visit-times-average math, and how to act on what you find.
- [Safe to Spend: How BudgetGo Forecasts the Rest of Your Month](https://budgetgo.ai/blog/safe-to-spend-and-spending-forecast.html): What "safe to spend" means, how a spending forecast works (with the math), and how BudgetGo's Forecast and Safe to Spend help you stay on track for the rest of the month.
- [How to Stop Impulse Spending Without Feeling Deprived (With the Math)](https://budgetgo.ai/blog/impulse-spending.html): How to stop impulse spending without cutting out every treat: find your triggers, add a pause before you buy, give yourself a planned fun-money cap, and track it so the holiday sales don't take over.
- [How to Import a Bank Statement (PDF, CSV or Excel) Into a Budget App](https://budgetgo.ai/blog/import-bank-statement-pdf-csv.html): How to import a bank statement into a budget app step by step: download the right file from your bank, choose PDF, CSV or Excel, avoid duplicates, and check the results.
- [How to Stop Overspending Every Month (With the Math)](https://budgetgo.ai/blog/how-to-stop-overspending.html): How to stop overspending without guessing: measure your monthly gap, find the two categories causing it, set a weekly cap, and keep credit cards from hiding the overspend until the bill arrives.
- [How to Save Money on Your Heating Bill This Winter (With the Math)](https://budgetgo.ai/blog/how-to-save-money-on-heating-bill.html): How to save money on your heating bill this winter: estimate your monthly heating cost, make the cheap fixes that matter, and plan the winter months in your budget so a cold snap doesn't wreck it.
- [How to Save Money for Christmas in 6 Weeks (With the Math)](https://budgetgo.ai/blog/how-to-save-money-for-christmas.html): How to save money for Christmas with about six weeks to go: set a target, split it across your remaining paychecks, find the cash in your own spending, and start next year's Christmas fund in January.
- [How to Make a Budget From Scratch in 5 Steps (With the Math)](https://budgetgo.ai/blog/how-to-make-a-budget.html): How to make a budget from scratch in 5 steps: find your take-home pay, list what you really spend, do the math, set savings targets, and adjust after month one. Includes a full $3,800 example.

## Shortcuts actions

- [Add Transaction to Budget Go](https://budgetgo.ai/automations.html#wallet): Inputs are Amount (required), Merchant (required), and Currency (optional ISO code, which defaults to the user's currency). Used by the Wallet "Transaction" automation.
- [Import SMS Transaction](https://budgetgo.ai/automations.html#sms): Inputs are Message (required, the SMS content) and Sender (optional). Used by the Messages automation.
